status: fixture compiled against baseline and candidate; Linux execution pending
purpose: Record existing resumable work behavior before extracting any production switch phases into helpers.
shared_fixture_contract: The candidate fixture is compiled against each subject checkout through -I SUBJECT. It directly includes that subject's app_program/subsystem3/bc_decoder.c; no production test hook or replacement decoder is introduced.

coverage.phases: Every existing RW_* phase, plus unknown phase values 0 and 255.
boundaries: Primary extrema update/reversal/capacity and EOF with rising/falling state
Faint white/ink/valley transitions, exact 30000 us dip boundary and same-cursor transitions
Pruning minimum tie, scan/copy endpoints and exact/excess extrema counts
Strong/weak/faint edges, missing crossing, repeated crossing, intermediate and final segment samples
Direct decode, reversed widths, conflicting retained candidate and zero-width input
Fit orientation/star selection, ticks -64/0/63/64, fit budget 31/32, shared/varying outcomes, sign and half-narrow delta boundaries
Apply positive/negative/odd biases, invalid input and partial scratch mutation before failure
Leading quiet validation, faint fallback, terminal and unknown phases
Defined uint32 timestamp arithmetic wrap, leading/required-time saturation and valid maximum-range configuration arithmetic
coverage.complete_path_execution: work_begin followed by work_advance calls with budgets reset between calls; each call is traced until RW_DONE, with a 4096-call nontermination guard.
coverage.trace: Before/after rows contain every named s3_barcode_work_t scalar, all 127 ext entries, all 127 ext_us entries, all 29 runs, both narrow/chosen/trial_bias entries and candidate bits, plus configuration and relevant record counters/input state. Struct padding is excluded from semantic comparison.

assertions: Each supplied configuration satisfies the existing config_valid predicate.
work_units and fit_ticks remain monotonic and within their existing per-call caps; fit increments do not exceed work increments.
Exhausted work budget, exhausted fit budget at RW_FIT_TICK and RW_DONE preserve the entire input record.
A nonterminal single-unit boundary call consumes its one available work unit.
work_advance changes no bytes outside work, work_units and fit_ticks.
Fixture buffers and the complete-path loop stay bounded.

exception_inventory.exception: Host-only direct implementation include and private enum/helper access
exception_inventory.reason: Observe otherwise inaccessible phase/budget boundaries without changing firmware or public interfaces.
exception_inventory.limit: Synthetic internal states are bounded inputs to characterization; not every state is asserted publicly reachable. Unknown-phase and arithmetic results are recorded rather than assigned invented decoder expectations.

exception_inventory.exception: TRACE_U, TRACE_S and CASE fixture-local macros
exception_inventory.reason: Keep the named-field trace complete and reset every scenario from the same initialized seed. These macros do not enter production builds.

local_validation.kind: compile/link only; no generated Windows executable run
